interpretation: The tenfold native realization freedom is an intrinsic face-local chart gauge and transports naturally between faces. It is not tied to the canonical face or to a chosen native representative.
intrinsic_definition: D5_f is the kernel of the action of Stab(f) on the four native signed face blocks.
keeper: The pentagon is not attached to one chart. Native transport carries the chart gauge with the face.
naturality_proof: Let h be any native automorphism carrying face f to face f'.
Conjugation by h identifies Stab(f) with Stab(f').
The same h transports the four signed face blocks of f bijectively onto the four signed face blocks of f'.
Therefore the two four-block permutation representations are intertwined by conjugation.
Kernels of intertwined group actions correspond under the intertwining isomorphism.

theorem: For every native h in Aut(G60) carrying a face f to h(f), the face-local order-ten realization kernel is natural under transport: h D5_f h^-1 = D5_h(f).
